name: ( NEW WIG DRYER)
description:
Wigs by Mia Kelly Wig Dryer 💕

Simplify your wig-care routine with gentle warm airflow and an easy-to-use timer. The ventilated head-shaped stand circulates air throughout the wig cap to help dry your wig after washing.

Features include a working temperature of approximately 45–50°C (113–122°F), an adjustable 4–10 minute timer with automatic shutoff, and a continuous airflow setting. Its smooth, rounded design is easy to clean and store.

Please note: The manufacturer lists this model for wigs up to 25 cm (approximately 10 inches) long. Always check your wig’s heat-care instructions before use, especially for synthetic hair.
